title: A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined
abstract: arXiv:2610.01938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan.   This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged.   No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal

translated_title: 评估大语言模型临床推理能力的量规全景：已有什么、缺失什么、需要组合什么
translated_abstract: 考试式准确率并不能证明大语言模型（LLM）能够在临床病历上进行良好的推理。我们将临床推理定义为：跨时间和跨来源整合与更新证据，以形成、修订和论证患者的病情表征以及合理且可辩护的诊疗方案。本结构化叙述性综述梳理了三方面文献：医学教育评估工具、2023年以来发表的临床LLM基准测试，以及通用领域中用于评估长文本生成的方法。我们考察了六个维度：病情表征、时序综合、鉴别诊断与管理推理、反事实推理、校准的不确定性以及推理忠实性。预印本论文也被纳入并予以标注。没有任何单一工具能够覆盖全部六个维度。病情表征以及鉴别诊断/管理推理已得到较为合理的覆盖，尽管其可靠性因工具和应用场景而异。TIMER-Eval 针对时序……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该结构化综述系统梳理了用于评估大语言模型临床推理的医学教育工具、临床基准与长文本生成评估方法，覆盖病情表征、时序综合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、不确定性校准和推理忠实性六个维度，并指出目前没有任何单一工具能覆盖全部维度，需要将多种评估方法组合使用。
en_tdlr: This structured narrative review maps medical education instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks, and long-form generation evaluation methods across six clinical reasoning dimensions, finding that no single rubric covers all dimensions and that existing tools need to be combined for comprehensive evaluation.
